author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Character art: realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; lighter fantasy book; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, more if the style fits the series. Map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up 2026-09-21: still checking portfolios; send a link to previous work if not sent yet. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.

author: Temmycreative
title: Paid vector illustrator for Halloween apparel
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: one skeleton as the main character; punk/rock retro horror vibe; clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS); large back print (13" × 16"); neon green, purple & orange palette; original artwork only (no tracing existing designs). Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Follow-up: must be an Adobe Illustrator user; please DM if available. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @temmycreative_.

title: Freelance graphic designer for campaign visuals
